sources.title: ModelSaber
sources.snippet: Welcome to ModelSaber! ModelSaber is a repository for Avatars, Sabers, Platforms, and Bloqs. sources.title: BeardedMonster/SabiYarn-125M-finetune · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description SabiYarn-125M is the first of a series of transformer models (adopted from nanogpt and inspired by GPT-J's architecture) pretrained on a large corpus of Nigerian language data in a self-supervised fashion.

sources.title: BERT (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) is a language model introduced in October 2018 by researchers at Google. [2][3] It learns to represent text as a sequence of vectors using self-supervised learning. It uses the encoder-only transformer architecture.
